faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR CIRCOT PTMO recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Part-Time Medical Officer (PTMO) position is 09-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the PTMO post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree or an equivalent qualification from a recognized University or Institution. Registration with the NMC or State Medical Council is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any preference for experienced candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates who have a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in Government, Autonomous, or Private Hospitals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Part-Time Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the PTMO post is 65 years. However, relaxation up to 70 years may be considered in exceptional cases on a case-to-case basis.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the PTMO role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to be prepared for both stages.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Part-Time Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month for the Part-Time Medical Officer (PTMO) post.

faq.question: Q8. How should I apply for the ICAR CIRCOT PTMO vacancy?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with all required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at ICAR Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology, Mumbai, Maharashtra, 400019 on 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Maharashtra apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the location as Mumbai, Maharashtra. While not explicitly stated that only Maharashtra residents can apply, candidates should ensure they can attend the walk-in interview in Mumbai on the specified date.
